desc: Parse `N`, `M`, `X`, and build original outgoing adjacency lists and reversed adjacency lists.
Implement Dijkstra over states `(vertex, parity)` using 64-bit integer distances.
Add move transitions with cost 1 using the adjacency list corresponding to the current parity.
Add reversal transitions with cost X from `(v, 0)` to `(v, 1)` and from `(v, 1)` to `(v, 0)`.
Stop when either target state `(N, 0)` or `(N, 1)` is finalized and print the minimum distance.
Verify the implementation on the provided sample tests and ensure it handles large answers beyond 32-bit range.
